digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend assembly and port conformance
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend is missing two Backend protocol members (query_project and assert_env_ready), causing isinstance checks to fail despite registration
reconciler.backend config validator is locked to {"jira"} and rejects "jira-datacenter", making the registered backend unreachable via configuration
DC inbound identity minting fails silently because the accountId guard rejects DC users (which carry only name/key), preventing ghost identity creation that Cloud accomplishes
mapping backend vendor to family creation channel is required to prevent ValueError when the guard is fixed, but widening CREATION_CHANNELS would fork the store vocabulary across deployments
test_backend_contract.py fixture params exclude jira-datacenter, so the DC backend has never been held to generic port assertions despite J6 shipping it
a WRITING-mode reconcile pass crashes on set_entity_property, a core-required method not declared in TicketTransport protocol, indicating the port specification is incomplete
